title: Azure AI Providers
description: Endpoint and request shape for the Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry Anthropic providers registered with jupyterlite-ai.

azureOpenAI.title: Azure OpenAI
azureOpenAI.description: Deployment reached over the Azure OpenAI REST API.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Endpoint prefix, for example https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai. Overridden by the base URL set on the provider in the AI settings panel.

deployment.title: Deployment name
deployment.description: Azure deployment name, used as the model id. Overridden by the model set on the provider in the AI settings panel.

apiVersion.title: API version
apiVersion.description: Value of the api-version query parameter. Empty leaves the AI SDK default in place.

apiKeyHeader.title: API key header
apiKeyHeader.description: Header carrying the API key. Empty sends no key header.

dropDefaultAuthHeaders.title: Drop default auth headers
dropDefaultAuthHeaders.description: Remove x-api-key and authorization before sending.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Extra entries for the model dropdown.

pathPattern.title: Path rewrite pattern
pathPattern.description: Regular expression applied to the request path. Empty disables the rewrite.

azureFoundryAnthropic.title: Azure AI Foundry (Anthropic)
azureFoundryAnthropic.description: Anthropic models on Azure AI Foundry over the Anthropic messages API. The wire format is not verified against a tenant, so every part of the request is a setting.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Endpoint prefix the Anthropic messages path is appended to, for example https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic/v1. Overridden by the base URL set on the provider in the AI settings panel.

model.title: Model name
model.description: Model or deployment id sent in the request body. Overridden by the model set on the provider in the AI settings panel.

apiVersion.title: API version
apiVersion.description: Value of the api-version query parameter. Empty sends no api version.

apiKeyHeader.title: API key header
apiKeyHeader.description: Header carrying the API key. Set to x-api-key for a plain Anthropic endpoint.

dropDefaultAuthHeaders.title: Drop default auth headers
dropDefaultAuthHeaders.description: Remove the x-api-key and authorization headers the Anthropic SDK sets.

anthropicBeta.title: anthropic-beta header
anthropicBeta.description: Joined with commas. Empty sends no beta header.

allowDirectBrowserAccess.title: Allow direct browser access
allowDirectBrowserAccess.description: Send anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access, required for a browser request to an Anthropic endpoint.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Extra entries for the model dropdown.

pathPattern.title: Path rewrite pattern
pathPattern.description: Regular expression applied to the request path. Empty disables the rewrite.
